description: This Java source file defines the class TenantIdentifierLoggingConverter, which is a custom logback converter used for logging tenant identifiers in a multi-tenant system. It extends ClassicConverter and overrides the convert method to insert tenant info into log entries.

classes.name: TenantIdentifierLoggingConverter
classes.description: A custom logback converter that inserts tenant identification into log messages for multi-tenant logging context.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Overrides the convert method to return the current tenant's identifier or 'no-tenant' if none is set.
